subject: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Arielle Cole <arielle@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)

Hi team,

Quick note as finance is finalizing the Q4 commit: ClearWave is asking for a go/no-go on their expansion bundle this week so they can lock budget. Right now the opportunity in SFDC is at "Negotiation" but we still need a short internal sync to confirm the stage and whether we can mark the revenue for Q4.

Key open items:
- Pricing finalization (attached pricing_summary_v2.pdf) — procurement had a couple redlines.
- MUTUAL ACTION PLAN signoff — I attached an updated MAP (ClearWave_Mutual_Action_Plan_Q4.xlsx).
- Technical acceptance gating — CS to confirm current pilot KPIs are met.

Ask: Monica/CS — can you confirm whether ClearWave meets our technical rollout acceptance criteria by EOD Wednesday so Finance can include the expansion in the Q4 forecast? If not, what blockers remain and a target remedial date?

I'll follow up with Neha to understand sensitivity on the commit (what happens if we slip to Jan).

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arielle Cole <arielle@clearwavehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)

Marcus — thanks for the heads up. Quick update from the CS side after this morning's check-in with Arielle and Sam:

- Pilot KPIs: latency and throughput targets are within the agreed thresholds for the core workflow. Customer success has validated logs and they passed the smoke tests on 9/20.
- Remaining items: role-based access for one integration (SFTP ingestion) is pending — engineering estimated 5 business days to finish.
- Customer sentiment: very positive; they're ready to roll once the SFTP task is cleared.

So my recommendation is: we can mark the stage as "Contracting — final technical dependency" and treat the SFTP task as a committed action with an estimated remediation completion of 2026-09-28. If Finance needs a date to include in Q4, I can push for an accelerated fix next week and confirm by EOD Wednesday.

Arielle — can you confirm procurement's timeline? If procurement can sign the DocuSign by next week, that helps.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Arielle Cole <arielle@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clarity. Procurement has one legal item to tidy (data localization clause) but procurement confirmed they can sign DocuSign by 2026-09-29 if we accept our standard addendum. Sam and I discussed prioritizing SFTP integration this week to avoid slipping the budget approval.

We are aiming to have signatures and internal approval before 9/30. If Redwood can commit to the SFTP fix by 9/28, ClearWave will include the expansion in their internal Q4 budget submission.

Best,
Arielle
Director of Technology, ClearWave Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Arielle Cole <arielle@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)

Marcus/Monica — finance perspective: if we receive signed DocuSign and CS confirms SFTP remediation by 2026-09-28, we can include the ARR upside for this expansion in the Q4 commit. If either of those slips beyond 9/30, the conservative treatment is to push revenue to Q1.

Two notes for clarity:
1) Please confirm the exact plan that will be attached to the SFDC opportunity (I need the MAP filename and signoff date).
2) If we are stretching for an accelerated engineering window, confirm who on the Redwood side owns the delivery escalation so finance can account for risk.

I'll tentatively hold the amount in our forecast but will mark it as "conditional" until we get the signatures + CS confirmation.

-Neha
Senior FP&A Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arielle Cole <arielle@clearwavehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenlight request: stage clearance for ClearWave expansion (Q4 planning)

Thanks everyone — quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Decisions:
- Stage: mark SFDC stage as "Contracting — final technical dependency" (Marcus will update).
- Finance: Neha will include the ARR upside as "conditional Q4" pending signatures + SFTP confirmation.

Action items:
- Monica: push engineering to complete SFTP integration by 2026-09-28 and confirm via a short status email to this thread.
- Marcus: upload signed MAP and pricing summary to the SFDC opportunity and attach the DocuSign link.
- Arielle/Procurement: target DocuSign signature by 2026-09-29.
- Neha: hold the amount in forecast as conditional and notify FP&A on 2026-10-01 if everything is green.

Attachments referenced above. If anyone thinks we need an escalation call with Eng + CS + Finance tomorrow, say so and I'll set it up. Otherwise I'll update SFDC and follow up after Monica confirms the SFTP timeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this one matters for Q4 planning.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
